answer: A newcomer docks at the jetty of the trust graph holding near-zero weight; standing is earned only as independent peers attest to real work over many epochs, the way a grove thickens ring by ring. Each identity posts a refundable collateral bond that unlocks slowly, so a clone fleet must fund a separate stake and serve its own vesting window per fake. Sybil cost scales linearly, and accrued reputation stays hard to forge as carved marble.
